name: Ch D'ISSAN 2023

name: Ch Ducru Beaucaillou 2023

name: Ch Faugeres Reserve du Chateau 2019

name: Ch Ferriere 2023

name: Ch Gazin 2010
note: “A subtle red with ultra-fine tannins that accentuate a palate of chocolate, berries and nuts. Full and very round. It's refined and beautiful. Hard not to drink now but wait at least five years. Top wine from Gazin.” – James Suckling 95 Points

name: Ch Gazin 2018

name: Ch Gracia 2022
note: “A solid core of fruit with a freshness and brightness. Medium body. Creamy fine tannins. Serious finish.” – James Suckling 94-95 Points

name: Ch Grand Puy Ducasse 2008

name: Ch Grand Puy Ducasse 2010

name: Ch Gruaud Larose 2021
note: This famous and historic Saint Julien 2nd growth is popular throughout the world. This is a large vineyard of 82 hectare which surrounds the chateau and has changed little in size since the 1855 classification.

name: Ch Haut Bages Liberal 2017

note: “This sits on the edge of reduction, showing a lovely, savory dark-fruit profile with a delicate yet compacted nature. The midweight palate has a luscious and inviting mouthfeel, fine-grained tannins and a balanced, mouthwatering acidity.” – James Suckling 94 Points

name: Dominique Lafon Pernand Vergelesses 2023
note: Fresh orchard fruit and white blossom lead the nose, accented by subtle stone and almond notes. The palate is balanced and quietly textured, combining ripeness with tension. A gentle saline note adds complexity through the finish. Understated, elegant Burgundy with clarity and charm.

name: Dominique Lafon Volnay 2023
note: “Perfumed and floral with delicate notes of cherries, dried strawberries, flowers and earth. The midweight palate has fine-grained tannins and a plush, rounded mouthfeel that balances minerality and high-toned fruit. There's so much early-drinking pleasure here with great aging potential

name: Dominique Lafon Volnay Lurets 1ER Cru 2023
note: Perfumed and expressive, this Volnay opens with wild strawberry, rose, and subtle spice. The palate is supple and flowing, with fine-grained tannins shaping its elegant core. Earthy nuances add depth without weight. A sensual, finely detailed red with graceful persistence.

name: Louis Latour Beaune Perrieres 1ER Cru 2023
note: “A rich and wild Beaune with aromas and flavors of dried berries, strawberries, earth and spice. Medium to full body with depth and richness. So much spicy fruit as well as nutmeg and coffee beans. Wonderful.” – James Suckling 97 Points

name: Louis Latour Bellevue Pinot Noir 2024
note: Light and expressive, this Pinot Noir offers aromas of red cherry, raspberry, and a hint of rose petal. The palate is supple and fresh, with gentle tannins and bright acidity. Subtle earthy notes emerge on the finish, adding nuance. An easygoing, elegant red made for early enjoyment.

name: Louis Latour Chambolle Musigny 2021
note: “This red leans to the tart side, offering black currant, blackberry, violet and mineral flavors. Concentrated and vigorous, with a supple texture that turns chalky on the long finish.” – Wine Spectator 92 Points

name: Louis Latour Chateau Corton Grancey Grand Cru 2023
note: “Fresh, lively and elegant, this is not at all what the world expects from this Grand Cru, but it is so exciting, whipping across your palate at a very brisk clip. Silky tannins and a really long, stony finish with terrific energy.” – James Suckling 97 Points

name: Louis Latour Clos Vougeot Grand Cru 2019

name: Louis Latour Mazis Chambertin 2016

name: Louis Latour Romanee St Vivant les Quatre Journaux Grand Cru 2018

name: Louis Latour Vosne Romanee Rouge 2023
note: A deep ruby colour characterizes our Vosne-Romanee 2023. The nose reveals aromas of mocha and undergrowth. The palate is full-bodied, with silky tannins and notes of morello cherry and blackcurrant. The finish is airy.

name: Louis Latour Vosne Romanee les Chaumes 2017
note: Perfumed and seductive, this Premier Cru reveals red berry fruit, rose petal, and exotic spice. The palate is supple and layered, with silky tannins and a caressing texture. Notes of truffle and incense emerge on the finish, adding complexity. A sensual Vosne with graceful aging potential.

name: Pierre Gelin Bourgogne Cote D'OR Pinot Noir 2024
note: Bright and juicy, with red cherry, raspberry and cranberry layered with subtle earth and spice. Fresh and energetic on the palate, with fine tannins and an attractive fruit-driven finish.

sources.name: Pierre Gelin Bourgogne Cote D'OR Pinot Noir 2024

name: Pierre Gelin Chambertin Clos de Beze Grand Cru 2019
note: “A flashy version, this boasts vanilla and toasty oak aromas and flavors, with macerated black cherry, plum, licorice and mint. Supple and refined, with a long, spice- and mineral-tinged aftertaste. So harmonious that it feels approachable now, but be patient.” – Wine Spectator 95

sources.name: Pierre Gelin Chambertin Clos de Beze Grand Cru 2019

name: Pierre Gelin Chambertin Clos de Beze Grand Cru 2020
note: “Ripe, exotic even, boasting steeped cherry, raspberry, violet, sandalwood and stone flavors allied to a silky texture. Bracing acidity keeps this focused, while the refined tannins add rhythm. Turns more subtle as the finish extends, yet this is very persistent.” – Wine Spectator

sources.name: Pierre Gelin Chambertin Clos de Beze Grand Cru 2020

name: Pierre Gelin Fixin 2022
note: Vibrant aromas of red cherry and raspberry mingle with violet, earth and subtle spice. Medium-bodied and fresh, with fine tannins, lively acidity and a gently savoury, mineral finish.

name: Pierre Gelin Fixin Hervelets 1ER Cru 2022
note: Complex and savoury, offering ripe black cherry, wild blackberry and violet with baking spice and forest-floor nuances. Structured yet refined, with fine tannins and a persistent finish.

name: Pierre Gelin Fixin Napoleon Monopole 1ER Cru 2022
note: Elegant yet powerful, displaying cherry, raspberry, iron and spice. Richer and more structured in style, with ripe tannins, mineral depth and a long, intense fruit-and-spice finish.

sources.name: Pierre Gelin Fixin Napoleon Monopole 1ER Cru 2022

name: Pierre Gelin Fixin Napoleon Monopole 2023
note: Rich and structured, with cherry and raspberry layered with earth, mineral and warm wood spice. Concentrated yet balanced, with firm refined tannins and a long, savoury finish.

name: Pierre Gelin Gevrey Chambertin Clos Prieur 2022
note: Dark and complex, with blackberry and black cherry accompanied by herbs, florals and sweet spice. Medium-bodied with sturdy polished tannins, mineral freshness and a long, juicy finish.

name: Louis Latour Batard Montrachet Clos Poirier Grand Cru 2023
note: “Aromas of sliced, perfectly cooked apples, subtle pie crust and hints of chalk and white pepper. Full-bodied with integration and clarity to the wine. Long and focused, racy finish. Turns flinty and energized. So spicy. Almost burning. Powerful.” – James Suckling 98 Points

name: Louis Latour Batard Montrachet Grand Cru 2022
note: Our Batard-Montrachet 2022 has a pale gold colour. Its intense nose reveals aromas of yellow fruit and golden brioche. Full and round on the palate, it offers sappy and smoky flavours. Nice minerality on the finish.

sources.name: Louis Latour Batard Montrachet Grand Cru 2022

name: Louis Latour Batard Montrachet Grand Cru 2023
note: Opulent and generous, with floral aromas, vanilla, smoke and toast. The palate is broad and rich, showing toasted almond and marzipan, balanced by good tension and a long, polished finish.

sources.name: Louis Latour Batard Montrachet Grand Cru 2023

name: Louis Latour Chablis Ac 2024*Damaged Label
note: Pure and mineral-driven, this Chablis showcases aromas of lemon, green apple, and wet stone. The palate is taut and precise, with vibrant acidity and a distinctive chalky edge. Fresh citrus notes carry through to a crisp, saline finish. A textbook Chablis that highlights clarity and finesse.

name: Louis Latour Chablis les Clos Grands Cru 2022
note: Our Chablis Grand Cru “Les Clos” 2020 has a pale yellow color with green reflections. Its nose reveals notes of almond paste and yellow peach. Its palate, ample and round, offers notes of vanilla and brioche to conclude on a mineral and saline finish.

sources.name: Louis Latour Chablis les Clos Grands Cru 2022

name: Louis Latour Chablis les Clos Grands Cru 2023
note: Powerful yet precise, with ripe citrus, orchard fruit and chalky mineral notes. The palate is concentrated and fresh, with firm acidity, a stony saline character and a long, structured finish typical of Les Clos. The 2023 bottling is confirmed as Chardonnay from Chablis Grand Cru Les Clos.

sources.name: Louis Latour Chablis les Clos Grands Cru 2023

name: Louis Latour Chardonnay de L'ARDECHE Blanc 2021
note: Light and refreshing, with sage, lemon verbena and fresh almond opening into hawthorn, citrus and floral notes. Well structured yet easy-drinking, with lively freshness and a clean finish.

sources.name: Louis Latour Chardonnay de L'ARDECHE Blanc 2021

name: Louis Latour Chassagne Montrachet Blanc 2023
note: Bright and floral, this white Burgundy bursts with aromas of citrus zest, pear, and almond blossom. On the palate, it shows both freshness and creaminess, with discreet oak adding depth. The finish is clean, mineral-driven, and precise. A lively Chassagne full of youthful character.

name: Louis Latour Corton Charlemagne Grand Cru 2023
note: “Fantastic depth and length to this wine, showing aromas and flavors of sliced apples, stone, flint,matchstick and white pepper. It's full-bodied and reserved, with very fine layers of bright fruit and minerals. Tight, structured and compact with a long finish.” – James Suckl

sources.name: Louis Latour Corton Charlemagne Grand Cru 2023

name: Louis Latour Criots Batard Montrachet Grand Cru 2019
note: Our Criots-Batard-Montrachet 2019 has a brilliant colour with golden hues, revealing aromas of marzipan, vanilla and acacia honey. Ample and very generous on the palate, roasting note follows the vanilla and almond aromas. A persistent finish full of freshness.

sources.name: Louis Latour Criots Batard Montrachet Grand Cru 2019

name: Louis Latour Pouilly Fuisse 2023
note: Our Pouilly-Fuisse 2023 has a bright and pale yellow color, with a floral nose of acacia and honeysuckle. Full and round on the palate, it again reveals honeysuckle aromas associated with notes of fresh almond. The finish is long and persistent.

name: Louis Latour Puligny Montrachet Sous le Puits 1ER Cru 2023
note: “Aromas of flint, grapefruit rind, orchard fruit, chalk and fresh herbs. The high-tension palate is precise with mineral-driven acidity and a textural, rounded mouthfeel.” – James Suckling 95 Points
